annotations.title: OFAC sanctions screening for crypto wallet addresses

description: Is this wallet sanctioned? Screens 1-20 addresses (EVM 0x on any chain, Bitcoin, TRON, Solana, Litecoin, XRP, Monero, Zcash, ...) against every digital-currency address on the US Treasury OFAC SDN list (18 asset lists, refreshed from the official data). Use before your agent sends, pays, accepts or onboards crypto. Exact match -> verdict match (do not transact). English + Chinese advice. Not legal advice. PAID: $0.005 per call or 5 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/ofac-sanctions-check.

address.description: Wallet address to screen (any chain; an ethereum:/bitcoin:/tron: URI prefix is stripped)

addresses.description: Optional: more addresses, comma-separated (total max 20 per call)
